explanation: In 2006 Israel fought a party-militia that the civil war had produced and that the settlement ending the war had left armed. Hezbollah formed during the Israeli invasion and occupation of the south from 1982. The Taif agreement of 1989 disarmed the other militias and exempted the resistance to the occupation. Israel withdrew in 2000 and the exemption stayed. So in July 2006 the Lebanese state was not fighting and could not restrain the militia that was. The edge claims that inheritance. It says nothing about the raid that started the fighting.
